usedFor: Financial Cents holds clients and contacts for accountants, and HubSpot mirrors them when “New Client” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Financial Cents, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new client lands in HubSpot as a contact, and an existing one is updated instead of doubled.

watchOut: “Delete Client” and “Delete Contact” also run “Create or Update Contact”, so leave those two triggers out.
